topics.title: Tense Mastery (Perfect & Perfect Continuous)
topics.description: Menguasai present/past/future perfect dan perfect continuous.

questions.question: They ___ in Bandung since 2018.
questions.explanation: Penanda "since 2018" (dari titik waktu lampau hingga sekarang) memerlukan present perfect: have/has+V3.

questions.question: She was exhausted; she ___ all morning.
questions.explanation: Konteks lampau ("was exhausted") dengan penekanan durasi sebelum titik lampau lain → past perfect continuous: had been+V-ing.

questions.question: By next June we ___ here for ten years.
questions.explanation: Penanda "by next June" + penekanan durasi yang masih berlangsung sampai titik masa depan → future perfect continuous: will have been+V-ing.

questions.question: I ___ this film three times so far.
questions.explanation: Penanda "three times so far" menekankan jumlah/hasil, bukan durasi → present perfect: have+V3.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat yang benar terkait pemakaian stative verb dengan perfect continuous:
options: She has known him since 9 continuously.
She has been knowing him since 9.
questions.explanation: Stative verb seperti "know" tidak boleh dipakai dalam bentuk continuous; "writing" adalah action verb sehingga sah dipakai dengan perfect continuous.

questions.question: When we arrived, he ___ the report already.
questions.explanation: Aksi selesai sebelum aksi lampau lain ("when we arrived") → past perfect: had+V3.

questions.question: Rumus present perfect continuous adalah ___.
questions.explanation: Present perfect continuous dibentuk dengan have/has + been + V-ing, menekankan durasi yang masih terasa efeknya.

questions.question: The ground was wet because it ___.
questions.explanation: Sebab yang terjadi sebelum kondisi lampau lain ("was wet") → past perfect continuous: had been+V-ing, menekankan proses yang menyebabkan efek tersebut.

questions.question: Untuk mengubah kalimat dari present ke past perfect (pindah waktu), yang diganti adalah ___.
questions.explanation: Rumus aspek (V3, V-ing) tidak berubah; yang berpindah hanya auxiliary: has → had → will have.

questions.question: Pilih bentuk yang tepat: "I ___ three books this month." (menekankan jumlah, bukan proses)
questions.explanation: Penekanan pada hasil/jumlah ("three books") → present perfect (fokus hasil), bukan perfect continuous (fokus proses).

questions.question: She ___ (live) in Jakarta for five years now.
questions.explanation: Durasi dari masa lalu sampai sekarang, fokus hasil → present perfect: has+V3.

questions.question: I ___ (wait) for two hours when the bus finally came.
questions.explanation: Durasi yang berlangsung sebelum kejadian lampau lain ("the bus came") → past perfect continuous.

questions.question: By the time she graduates, she ___ (study) English for eight years.
questions.explanation: Durasi yang masih berlangsung sampai titik masa depan ("by the time...graduates") → future perfect continuous.

questions.question: He ___ (just/finish) his homework when I called.
questions.explanation: Aksi baru selesai sebelum aksi lampau lain → past perfect, dengan "just" menegaskan kedekatan waktu.

questions.question: We ___ (know) each other since childhood.
questions.explanation: "Know" adalah stative verb, tidak dipakai continuous; durasi dari masa lalu ke sekarang → present perfect biasa.

questions.question: I have been knowing him since 2015. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: "Know" adalah stative verb yang tidak dipakai dalam bentuk continuous; gunakan present perfect biasa "have known".

questions.question: She has been finished the report before we arrived. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Konteks lampau ("before we arrived") memerlukan past perfect "had finished", bukan present perfect continuous.

questions.question: By next year, they will lived here for a decade. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Aksi yang selesai/berlangsung sampai titik masa depan memerlukan future perfect "will have lived".

questions.question: He have written three novels so far. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Subjek tunggal "He" memerlukan auxiliary "has", bukan "have".

questions.question: The ground was wet because it has been raining all night. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Konteks kalimat lampau ("was wet") memerlukan past perfect continuous "had been raining", bukan present perfect continuous.

topics.title: Subject-Verb Agreement
topics.description: Kesesuaian subjek dan kata kerja dalam berbagai konteks.

questions.question: The list of names ___ on the wall.
questions.explanation: "Of names" adalah frasa penyela; subjek sebenarnya "the list" (tunggal) → verb "is".

questions.question: Neither the boys nor Ani ___ there.
questions.explanation: Pola "neither...nor" mengikuti subjek terdekat ("Ani", tunggal) → verb "was".

questions.question: Everyone ___ a ticket.
questions.explanation: "Everyone" adalah indefinite pronoun yang selalu dianggap tunggal → verb "has".

questions.question: The news ___ good today.
questions.explanation: "News" berakhiran -s tapi bermakna tunggal → verb "is".

questions.question: Ten years ___ a long time.
questions.explanation: Ungkapan waktu dihitung sebagai satu kesatuan (unit) → verb tunggal "is".

questions.question: There ___ two chairs here.
questions.explanation: Pada pola "there is/are", verb menyesuaikan kata benda sesudahnya ("two chairs", jamak) → "are".

questions.question: A number of students ___ late.
questions.explanation: "A number of" + noun jamak berarti "beberapa", dianggap jamak → verb "are".

questions.question: Mathematics ___ my favourite subject.
questions.explanation: "Mathematics" berakhiran -s tapi bermakna tunggal (nama mata pelajaran) → verb "is".

questions.question: The box of tools ___ heavy.
questions.explanation: "Of tools" adalah frasa penyela; subjek sebenarnya "the box" (tunggal) → verb "is".

questions.question: Each student ___ one copy.
questions.explanation: "Each" selalu dianggap tunggal → verb + s/es: "needs".

questions.question: The list of items are long. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Subjek sebenarnya "the list" (tunggal), bukan "items" → kata kerja "is".

questions.question: Everyone have a ticket for the show. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: "Everyone" adalah indefinite pronoun tunggal → kata kerja "has".

questions.question: The news are shocking to everyone. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: "News" secara gramatikal tunggal meski berakhiran -s → kata kerja "is".

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the employees was informed. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Pada pola neither...nor, kata kerja mengikuti subjek terdekat ("employees", jamak) → "were".

questions.question: There is three books on the table. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Subjek sebenarnya "three books" (jamak) → "there are".

topics.title: Modal Verbs
topics.description: Modal untuk deduksi, kemungkinan, dan kewajiban di masa lalu.

questions.question: You ___ touch that wire — it's dangerous.
questions.explanation: "Mustn't" menyatakan larangan keras (prohibition), sesuai konteks bahaya.

questions.question: It ___ rain tonight — langitnya gelap.
questions.explanation: "Might" menyatakan kemungkinan 50:50 berdasarkan tanda-tanda (langit gelap), bukan kepastian.

questions.question: She ___ swim when she was five.
questions.explanation: "Could" adalah bentuk lampau dari "can" untuk menyatakan kemampuan di masa lalu.

questions.question: Pilih bentuk yang benar:
questions.explanation: Golden rule modal: tidak ada -s/-es dan tidak ada "to" setelah modal — "can go" bentuk V1 murni.

questions.question: I ___ submit it today — atasan yang meminta.
questions.explanation: "Have to" menyatakan keharusan dari pihak luar/aturan (atasan), berbeda dari "must" yang dari diri sendiri.

questions.question: You look pale. You ___ rest.
questions.explanation: "Should" menyatakan saran (advice) yang sesuai konteks kepedulian terhadap kondisi seseorang.

questions.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar tentang "don't have to"?
options: Berarti tidak wajib, boleh dilakukan boleh tidak.
questions.explanation: "Don't have to" = "don't need to" (tidak wajib), berbeda jauh maknanya dari "mustn't" (larangan keras).

questions.question: Bentuk lampau dari must (keharusan) adalah ___.
questions.explanation: "Must" tidak memiliki bentuk lampau sendiri; digunakan "had to" untuk menyatakan keharusan di masa lalu.

questions.question: ___ you help me, please?
questions.explanation: "Would you...?" adalah bentuk permintaan yang sopan/elegan (polite request).

questions.question: Penyesalan atas tindakan lampau: You ___ told me.
questions.explanation: "Should have + V3" menyatakan penyesalan atas sesuatu yang seharusnya dilakukan di masa lalu tapi tidak dilakukan.

questions.question: The street is wet. It ___ (must) rain last night.
questions.explanation: Bukti kuat mengarah pada kesimpulan pasti tentang masa lalu → "must have" (deduksi logis kuat).

questions.question: You ___ (could) died in that accident! Be more careful next time.
questions.explanation: Kemungkinan buruk yang untungnya tidak terjadi di masa lalu → "could have + V3".

questions.question: She ___ (might) missed the bus; that's why she's late.
questions.explanation: Dugaan/kemungkinan (bukan kepastian) tentang masa lalu → "might have + V3".

questions.question: Students ___ (must not) use phones during the exam.
questions.explanation: Larangan tegas (prohibition) → "mustn't", berbeda dari "don't have to" yang berarti tidak wajib.

questions.question: Tomorrow is Sunday. You ___ (not need to) wake up early.
questions.explanation: Tidak ada kewajiban (absence of obligation), bukan larangan → "don't have to".

questions.question: This exam is ___ than the last one.
questions.explanation: Adjective 2 suku kata berakhiran -y ("easy") diubah menjadi -ier untuk comparative: "easier".

questions.question: He is the ___ student in class.
questions.explanation: Adjective 2+ suku kata ("careful") memakai "the most" untuk superlative, bukan akhiran -est.

questions.question: Ani is ___ Budi — tingginya sama.
questions.explanation: Pola kesetaraan (equal comparison) menggunakan "as + adjective + as".

questions.question: Pilih superlative yang benar dari 'good':
questions.explanation: "Good" adalah adjective irregular: good → better → the best.

questions.question: This road is ___ than that one.
questions.explanation: Adjective 1 suku kata ("safe") ditambah -er untuk comparative: "safer".

questions.question: ___ you practice, ___ you get.
options: The more hard / the more good
questions.explanation: Pola "the + comparative, the + comparative" menyatakan dua hal yang berubah sejalan (correlative comparison).

questions.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar?
options: "The most best" adalah superlative yang benar.
"More taller" adalah bentuk comparative yang benar.
Comparative selalu memakai "more" apapun jumlah suku katanya.
"More taller" adalah bentuk yang salah karena double comparative.
questions.explanation: Hanya boleh satu penanda comparative: "-er" ATAU "more", tidak boleh keduanya sekaligus ("more taller" salah).

questions.question: Bad → ___ → the worst.
questions.explanation: "Bad" adalah adjective irregular: bad → worse → the worst.

questions.question: My score is ___ than yours.
questions.explanation: Comparative dari "bad" adalah "worse" (irregular), digunakan dengan "than".

questions.question: Superlatif hampir selalu didahului ___.
questions.explanation: Bentuk superlative diawali determiner "the" karena menunjuk hal yang paling unik/spesifik dalam kelompoknya.

questions.question: This mountain track is ___ (less/dangerous) than the previous one.
questions.explanation: "Less + adjective" menyatakan tingkat yang lebih rendah dibanding pembanding.

questions.question: The scenery here is ___ (much/beautiful) than in the city.
questions.explanation: "Much" sebagai intensifier comparative adjective panjang: "much more + adjective".

questions.question: My house is ___ (far) from school than yours.
questions.explanation: "Farther" dipakai untuk jarak fisik; "further" untuk makna tambahan/abstrak.

questions.question: For ___ (far) information, please contact our admin office.
questions.explanation: "Further" dipakai untuk makna abstrak/tambahan (bukan jarak fisik).

questions.question: This tent is ___ (a bit/big) than ours.
questions.explanation: "A bit" sebagai modifier comparative adjective pendek: "a bit + adjective-er".

questions.question: "Because she finished it" adalah klausa ___.
questions.explanation: Diawali subordinator "because" sehingga tidak bisa berdiri sendiri sebagai kalimat lengkap — dependent clause.

questions.question: "She finished her homework." adalah klausa ___.
questions.explanation: Memiliki S+V lengkap tanpa kata penghubung penunduk, dan bisa berdiri sendiri — independent clause.

questions.question: "He runs, and she cycles." termasuk kalimat ___.
questions.explanation: Dua independent clause dihubungkan coordinating conjunction ("and") — compound sentence.

questions.question: "He runs because he likes it." termasuk ___.
questions.explanation: Satu independent clause + satu dependent clause ("because he likes it") — complex sentence.

questions.question: Yang termasuk FANBOYS adalah ___.
questions.explanation: "But" adalah salah satu dari 7 coordinating conjunction (FANBOYS); lainnya adalah subordinator.

questions.question: Setiap klausa wajib memiliki ___.
questions.explanation: Definisi klausa: gabungan kata yang mengandung minimal satu subjek dan satu verba (finite).

questions.question: "He runs and she cycles when it is cool." adalah ___.
questions.explanation: Terdapat dua independent clause (he runs, she cycles) + satu dependent clause (when it is cool) — compound-complex.

questions.question: "Although it rained" bisa berdiri sendiri sebagai kalimat.
questions.explanation: Diawali subordinator "although" sehingga bergantung pada klausa lain — tidak bisa berdiri sendiri sebagai kalimat.

questions.question: Kata "although" berfungsi sebagai ___.
questions.explanation: "Although" menghubungkan dependent clause ke induk kalimat, sehingga berfungsi sebagai subordinating conjunction.

questions.question: Kalimat simple berisi ___.
questions.explanation: Simple sentence terdiri dari tepat satu independent clause tanpa klausa tambahan.

questions.question: I don't know ___ he wants.
questions.explanation: "What he wants" berfungsi sebagai objek verb "know" (noun clause), memakai susunan S+V, bukan susunan tanya.

questions.question: The student ___ sits in front is my cousin.
questions.explanation: "Who" menggantikan orang sebagai subjek adjective clause yang menerangkan "the student".

questions.question: ___ it rained, we kept walking.
questions.explanation: "Although" adalah subordinator adverbial clause yang menyatakan pertentangan (concession).

questions.question: The book ___ you lent me was great.
questions.explanation: "That" menggantikan benda ("the book") sebagai objek dalam adjective clause.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat noun clause yang benar (bukan susunan tanya):
options: I wonder that he telling the truth.
I wonder he is telling truth whether.
I wonder whether he is telling the truth.
I wonder whether is he telling the truth.
I wonder does he tell the truth.
questions.explanation: Noun clause memakai susunan S+V normal (he is telling), bukan susunan pertanyaan (is he telling).

questions.question: "Whose" dalam adjective clause menyatakan ___.
questions.explanation: "Whose" adalah relative pronoun posesif yang menunjukkan kepemilikan (contoh: "the woman whose car broke down").

questions.question: Klausa yang berfungsi sebagai objek kalimat termasuk jenis ___.
questions.explanation: Noun clause berperan sebagai kata benda dalam kalimat, termasuk sebagai objek (contoh: "I know that you are right").

questions.question: Adjective clause diletakkan ___.
options: tepat setelah kata benda yang diterangkannya
questions.explanation: Adjective clause harus menempel langsung setelah noun yang diterangkannya agar jelas rujukannya.

questions.question: Adverbial clause yang diletakkan di depan kalimat diikuti ___.
questions.explanation: Ketika adverbial clause diletakkan di awal kalimat (sebelum independent clause), diberi koma sesudahnya.

questions.question: "She told me that she was tired." — klausa "that she was tired" adalah ___.
questions.explanation: "That she was tired" berfungsi sebagai objek dari verb "told", sehingga tergolong noun clause.

questions.question: This is the house ___ (where) I grew up.
questions.explanation: Klausa adjektiva yang merujuk pada tempat menggunakan relative adverb "where".

questions.question: I don't know ___ (where) she lives.
questions.explanation: Klausa nomina (noun clause) sebagai objek "know", merujuk tempat → "where".

questions.question: Call me ___ (when) you arrive.
questions.explanation: Klausa keterangan waktu (adverbial clause of time) menggunakan "when".

questions.question: He was so tired ___ he fell asleep immediately.
questions.explanation: Pola "so + adjective + that" untuk klausa keterangan hasil/akibat (adverbial clause of result).

questions.question: The woman ___ (whose) car broke down called a taxi.
questions.explanation: Klausa adjektiva yang menunjukkan kepemilikan menggunakan relative pronoun "whose".

topics.title: Gerund & Infinitive
topics.description: Penggunaan V-ing dan to-V setelah kata kerja tertentu.

questions.question: I can't stand ___ in line.
questions.explanation: "Can't stand" diikuti gerund (V-ing): "can't stand waiting".

questions.question: They decided ___ early.
questions.explanation: "Decide" adalah verb yang diikuti infinitive (to + V1): "decided to leave".

questions.question: She is good at ___ problems.
questions.explanation: Setelah preposition ("at"), selalu digunakan gerund: "good at solving".

questions.question: He suggested ___ a break.
questions.explanation: "Suggest" adalah verb yang diikuti gerund (V-ing): "suggested taking".

questions.question: This app is easy ___.
questions.explanation: Setelah adjective ("easy"), digunakan infinitive: "easy to use".

questions.question: "Stop smoking" dan "stop to smoke" berarti sama.
questions.explanation: "Stop smoking" = berhenti merokok, sedangkan "stop to smoke" = berhenti (aktivitas lain) untuk merokok — dua makna berbeda.

questions.question: Remember ___ the door before you go.
questions.explanation: "Remember to + V1" berarti ingat untuk melakukan sesuatu (belum dilakukan) — konteks pengingat sebelum pergi.

questions.question: We avoid ___ at night.
questions.explanation: "Avoid" adalah verb yang diikuti gerund (V-ing): "avoid driving".

questions.question: I look forward to ___ from you.
questions.explanation: "Look forward to" diikuti gerund karena "to" di sini adalah preposition, bukan infinitive marker.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat yang benar:
questions.explanation: "Promise" adalah verb yang diikuti infinitive (to + V1): "promised to call".

questions.question: He is interested in ___ (learn) new languages.
questions.explanation: Setelah preposisi ("in"), kata kerja berbentuk gerund: "learning".

questions.question: She finished ___ (write) her essay last night.
questions.explanation: "Finish" selalu diikuti gerund: "finished writing".

questions.question: They plan ___ (visit) Bali next month.
questions.explanation: "Plan" diikuti to-infinitive: "plan to visit".

questions.question: I regret ___ (tell) you this, but the trip is cancelled.
questions.explanation: "Regret to + V1" dipakai untuk menyampaikan berita buruk secara formal (berbeda makna dari "regret + V-ing").

questions.question: Try ___ (restart) the computer if it freezes.
questions.explanation: "Try + V-ing" berarti mencoba suatu metode/solusi (berbeda dari "try to + V1" yang berarti berusaha melakukan sesuatu yang sulit).

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 0 (fakta alam): if + V1, V1 — pola "If you heat ice, it melts."

questions.question: If it rains, we ___ home.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 1 (kemungkinan realistis masa depan): if + V1, will + V1.

questions.question: If I ___ you, I would apologize.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 2 (khayalan masa kini): semua subjek memakai "were" secara formal, meski subjeknya "I".

questions.question: If she ___, she would have passed.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 3 (penyesalan masa lalu): if + had + V3, would have + V3.

questions.question: Manakah aturan emas conditional yang benar?
options: Main clause tidak boleh memakai modal.
Semua tipe conditional memakai V1 di kedua klausa.
questions.explanation: Aturan emas: if-clause tidak memakai "will" — salah: "If it will rain"; benar: "If it rains".

questions.question: Fakta dari kalimat "If I had money, I would buy a tent." adalah:
options: I don't have money, but I bought a tent.
I will have money, so I will buy a tent.
I don't have money, so I don't buy a tent.
I have money, so I buy a tent.
I had money, so I bought a tent.
questions.explanation: Type 2 menyatakan fakta sebaliknya di present: karena if-clause negatif (tidak punya uang), faktanya adalah "tidak punya uang, tidak beli tenda".

questions.question: Pilih bentuk inversi formal yang benar dari 'If you need help, call me.':
options: Should you need help, call me.
Were you need help, call me.
Do you need help, call me.
Had you need help, call me.
questions.explanation: Inversi formal type 1 menggunakan "should" di depan tanpa "if": "Should you need help...".

questions.question: Pilih kalimat "unless" yang benar:
options: Unless it won't rain, we will go.
Unless it isn't raining, we will go.
Unless it not rains, we will go.
Unless it doesn't rain, we will go.
Unless it rains, we will go.
questions.explanation: "Unless" sudah bermakna negatif ("if...not"), sehingga tidak boleh ditambah "not" lagi — "unless it rains" = "if it doesn't rain".

questions.question: If they arrive early, we ___ at eight.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 1: if + V1, will + V1.

questions.question: If it hadn't rained, we ___ hiked.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 3: if + had V3 (negatif), would have + V3 di main clause.

questions.question: If water reaches 100°C, it ___ (boil).
questions.explanation: Conditional type 0 (kebenaran umum/ilmiah): if + present simple, present simple.

questions.question: If you don't hurry, you ___ (miss) the bus.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 1 (kemungkinan nyata di masa depan): if + present simple, will + V1.

questions.question: If he ___ (speak) French, he could work in Paris.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 2 (pengandaian tidak nyata masa kini): if + past simple, would/could + V1.

questions.question: If they had left earlier, they ___ (catch) the train.
questions.explanation: Conditional type 3 (pengandaian tidak nyata masa lalu): if + past perfect, would have + V3.

questions.question: Had she studied, she ___ (pass) the exam.
questions.explanation: Inversi conditional type 3 ("Had she studied" = "If she had studied"): would have + V3 pada klausa hasil.

questions.question: If it will rain, we will stay home. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Klausa "if" pada conditional type 1 tidak boleh memakai "will"; gunakan present simple "rains".

questions.question: If I was you, I would apologize. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Conditional type 2 formal memakai "were" untuk semua subjek (subjunctive mood), termasuk "I".

questions.question: She studied harder, she would have passed the exam. (perbaiki kesalahan pada "If she studied harder")
questions.explanation: Klausa hasil memakai "would have passed" (type 3) sehingga klausa if harus "had studied", bukan "studied".

questions.question: Unless it doesn't rain, we will cancel the picnic. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: "Unless" sudah bermakna negatif ("if...not"), sehingga klausanya tidak boleh double negative: "unless it rains".

questions.question: If you heat ice, it will melt. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Conditional type 0 (fakta ilmiah) memakai present simple pada kedua klausa: "it melts", bukan "will melt".

questions.question: The report ___ by the team last week.
questions.explanation: Konteks past simple ("last week") dalam passive: be(past)+V3 → "was submitted".

questions.question: The room ___ every morning.
questions.explanation: Konteks present simple/rutinitas dalam passive: be(present)+V3 → "is cleaned".

questions.question: It ___ already — tidak ada lagi di meja.
questions.explanation: Penanda "already" → present perfect passive: has/have been+V3.

questions.question: The bridge ___ next year.
questions.explanation: Konteks future dalam passive: will be+V3 → "will be built".

questions.question: The work must ___ today.
questions.explanation: Modal dalam passive: modal+be+V3 → "must be finished".

questions.question: "An accident was happened last night." adalah kalimat yang benar.
questions.explanation: "Happen" adalah verb intransitive (tanpa objek), sehingga tidak bisa dipasifkan — bentuk benar: "An accident happened last night."

questions.question: Rumus dasar passive voice adalah ___.
questions.explanation: Rumus inti passive voice: Subject + be + V3 (+ by Agent); hanya "be" yang mengikuti tense.

questions.question: Frasa "by + pelaku" ditulis bila ___.
questions.explanation: "By + agent" hanya ditulis ketika informasi pelaku dianggap penting bagi pembaca/pendengar.

questions.question: Dalam kalimat pasif, ___ menjadi subjek.
questions.explanation: Passive voice memindahkan objek kalimat aktif menjadi subjek kalimat pasif ("kamera" digeser ke objek).

questions.question: Yang menyesuaikan diri dengan tense pada passive voice adalah ___.
questions.explanation: Hanya bentuk "be" yang berubah sesuai tense; V3 (past participle) selalu tetap.

questions.question: The letter ___ (send) yesterday.
questions.explanation: Konteks lampau ("yesterday") + passive voice → past simple passive: "was sent".

questions.question: The house ___ (build) on a hill.
questions.explanation: Fakta umum dalam bentuk pasif → present simple passive: "is built".

questions.question: The bridge ___ (repair) at the moment.
questions.explanation: Penanda "at the moment" (sedang berlangsung) + pasif → present continuous passive: "is being repaired".

questions.question: The contract ___ (sign) by both sides yesterday.
questions.explanation: Konteks lampau ("yesterday") + pasif → past simple passive: "was signed".

questions.question: This medicine should ___ (take) regularly.
questions.explanation: Modal pasif: "should + be + V3" → "should be taken".

questions.question: An accident was happened near the school. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: "Happen" adalah verba intransitif, tidak bisa dipasifkan; gunakan bentuk aktif "happened".

questions.question: The room clean every morning by the staff. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Kalimat pasif kebiasaan ("every morning ... by the staff") memerlukan "is cleaned", bukan verba dasar.

questions.question: I am interested by nature. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Ungkapan pasif idiomatis "interested" berpasangan dengan preposisi "in", bukan "by".

questions.question: The work must finished by Friday. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Modal pasif memerlukan "be": "must be finished", bukan langsung V3 tanpa "be".

questions.question: The letter has sent already. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Present perfect pasif memerlukan "has been + V3": "has been sent".

topics.title: Reported Speech
topics.description: Perubahan kalimat langsung menjadi tidak langsung.

questions.question: She said she ___ tired at that moment.
questions.explanation: Reporting verb lampau ("said") memundurkan tense: am/is → was.

questions.question: He asked me where I ___ at that time.
questions.explanation: Reported question dengan backshift: live (V1) → lived (V2).

questions.question: "Close the door." → She told me ___ the door.
questions.explanation: Reported command (perintah) menggunakan pola: told + object + to + V1.

questions.question: will berubah menjadi ___ dalam reported speech.
questions.explanation: Backshift modal: will → would ketika reporting verb berbentuk lampau.

questions.question: today berubah menjadi ___ dalam reported speech.
questions.explanation: Penanda waktu "today" (sekarang) berubah menjadi "that day" (lampau) mengikuti kompas waktu reported speech.

questions.question: Pilih reported question yang benar:
options: He asked do I know it.
He asked if did I know it.
He asked did I know it.
He asked if I knew it.
questions.explanation: Reported yes/no question memakai "if/whether" + S+V (bukan susunan tanya dengan do/does/did).

questions.question: have + V3 berubah menjadi ___ dalam reported speech.
questions.explanation: Backshift: present perfect (have/has+V3) → past perfect (had+V3).

questions.question: here berubah menjadi ___ dalam reported speech.
questions.explanation: Penanda tempat "here" (dekat) berubah menjadi "there" (jauh) mengikuti kompas tempat reported speech.

questions.question: Kata ganti 'I' pada ucapan langsung biasanya berubah menjadi ___ dalam reported speech.
questions.explanation: Kata ganti orang pertama ("I") diubah sesuai siapa yang berbicara ketika dilaporkan orang lain, umumnya menjadi he/she.

questions.question: must (keharusan) pada reported speech menjadi ___.
questions.explanation: Backshift modal: must → had to ketika reporting verb berbentuk lampau.

questions.question: He says, "I like pizza." → He says ___ (that) he ___ (like) pizza.
questions.explanation: "Says" (present) tidak memicu backshift; kata kerja lapor tetap present: "that he likes".

questions.question: The teacher said, "The sun rises in the east." → The teacher said that the sun ___ (rise) in the east.
questions.explanation: Kebenaran umum/fakta ilmiah tidak mengalami backshift meski kata kerja lapor lampau: tetap "rises".

questions.question: "Where do you work?" she asked. → She asked where I ___ (work).
questions.explanation: Kata kerja lapor lampau ("asked") memicu backshift: present simple → past simple "worked".

questions.question: "Don't pick the flowers," the ranger warned. → The ranger warned us ___ pick the flowers.
questions.explanation: Perintah negatif langsung diubah menjadi "not to + V1" dalam reported speech.

questions.question: "I will call you tomorrow," he said. → He said he ___ (will/call) me the next day.
questions.explanation: Backshift modal: "will" → "would"; penanda waktu "tomorrow" → "the next day".

questions.question: He said that he is tired. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Kata kerja lapor lampau ("said") memicu backshift: present simple → past simple "was".

questions.question: She asked me where do I live. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Reported question menggunakan urutan kata pernyataan (bukan inversi tanya) dan backshift tense: "where I lived".

questions.question: He told me don't touch that. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Perintah negatif dalam reported speech: "not to + V1", bukan "don't + V1".

questions.question: They said they will finish it tomorrow. (perbaiki kesalahan)
options: would finish it the next day
will finish it the next day
questions.explanation: Backshift modal "will"→"would" dan penanda waktu "tomorrow"→"the next day" harus berubah bersamaan.

questions.question: She said she has lost her key yesterday. (perbaiki kesalahan)
questions.explanation: Kata kerja lapor lampau memicu backshift: present perfect → past perfect "had lost".

topics.title: Question Tags & Causative Verbs
topics.description: Tag question dan kata kerja kausatif (make/have/get/let).

questions.question: You have finished it, ___?
questions.explanation: Kalimat utama positif ("have finished") → tag negatif dengan auxiliary yang sama: "haven't you".

questions.question: She doesn't drive, ___?
questions.explanation: Kalimat utama negatif ("doesn't drive") → tag positif: "does she".

questions.question: Let's go, ___?
questions.explanation: Pola khusus "let's" selalu diikuti tag "shall we".

questions.question: I am late, ___?
questions.explanation: "I am" adalah perkecualian question tag: tag-nya adalah "aren't I", bukan "am not I".

questions.question: He made me ___ for an hour.
questions.explanation: Pola causative "make" tidak memakai "to": S + make + object + V1 murni.

questions.question: I had my car ___.
questions.explanation: Pola causative pasif "have + object + V3" berarti pekerjaan diserahkan pada orang lain, hasilnya yang penting.

questions.question: She got him ___ her.
questions.explanation: Pola causative "get" selalu memakai "to": S + get + person + to V1.

questions.question: Close it, ___?
questions.explanation: Kalimat imperative (perintah) menggunakan tag "will you".

questions.question: "Let" dalam causative verbs berarti ___.
questions.explanation: "Let" menyatakan izin/membiarkan (permission), paling lembut dibanding make/have/get.

questions.question: Causative verbs dipakai ketika pekerjaan ___.
options: dikerjakan orang lain, bukan diri sendiri
questions.explanation: Causative verb (make/have/get/let) menyatakan bahwa suatu tindakan dilakukan oleh/melalui orang lain, bukan oleh subjek sendiri.

questions.question: Everybody is enjoying the campfire, ___ they?
questions.explanation: "Everybody" tunggal untuk kata kerja, tetapi tag-nya memakai "they" (aturan khusus indefinite pronoun): "aren't they".

questions.question: Nobody brought the map, ___ they?
questions.explanation: "Nobody" bermakna negatif, sehingga tag-nya positif: "did they".

questions.question: There is a problem, ___ there?
questions.explanation: Pola "there is/are" pada question tag mengulangi kata "there": "isn't there".

questions.question: She helped me ___ (carry) the box.
questions.explanation: "Help" boleh diikuti V1 dengan atau tanpa "to": "helped me carry/to carry".

questions.question: We were made ___ (wait) outside.
questions.explanation: Dalam bentuk pasif dari "make", partikel "to" muncul kembali: "were made to wait".

questions.question: ___ tired, she went to bed early.
questions.explanation: Present participle (V-ing) menyatakan makna aktif dan sebab yang terjadi bersamaan — "Feeling tired" memendekkan "Because she felt tired".

questions.question: ___ in 1998, the novel still feels new.
questions.explanation: Past participle (V3) menyatakan makna pasif — "Written in 1998" = "which was written in 1998".

questions.question: ___ the work, they went home.
questions.explanation: Perfect participle (having + V3) menyatakan peristiwa yang terjadi lebih dulu sebelum aksi utama.

questions.question: Pilih phrasal verb yang bermakna 'menyerah':
questions.explanation: "Give up" berarti menyerah, berbeda dari "give in" (mengalah) meski mirip maknanya.

questions.question: Manakah contoh transitive phrasal verb yang TIDAK dapat dipisah?
questions.explanation: "Look after" adalah inseparable transitive phrasal verb — objek harus selalu setelah partikel, tidak bisa disisipkan di tengah.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat yang benar dengan kata ganti pada separable phrasal verb:
questions.explanation: Pada separable phrasal verb, kata ganti (it/them) wajib diletakkan di tengah, bukan setelah partikel.

questions.question: Manakah yang termasuk intransitive phrasal verb (tanpa objek)?
questions.explanation: "Take off" (lepas landas, tentang pesawat) tidak memerlukan objek — intransitive.

questions.question: ___ the news, they cheered.
questions.explanation: Present participle menyatakan aksi aktif yang terjadi bersamaan — "Hearing the news" = "When they heard the news".

questions.question: ___ by the flood, the bridge is closed.
questions.explanation: Past participle menyatakan makna pasif — "Damaged by the flood" = "which was damaged by the flood".

questions.question: ___ lost the map, we asked for help.
questions.explanation: Perfect participle "Having lost" menyatakan peristiwa (kehilangan peta) yang terjadi lebih dulu sebelum bertanya.

questions.question: ___ (walk) home, I met an old friend.
questions.explanation: Present participle menyatakan dua aksi yang terjadi bersamaan (berjalan sambil bertemu teman).

questions.question: ___ (leave) alone, the child began to cry.
questions.explanation: Past participle menyatakan makna pasif: "Left alone" = "who was left alone".

questions.question: ___ (read) the letter, he put it away.
questions.explanation: Perfect participle menyatakan urutan: membaca surat dulu, baru menyimpannya.

questions.question: I need to look ___ (mencari) my keys.
questions.explanation: "Look for" berarti mencari sesuatu.

questions.question: She always looks ___ (mengagumi) her older sister.
questions.explanation: "Look up to" berarti mengagumi seseorang.
